name: User Account
definition: A registered community member account, carrying profile attributes (display name, age, creation date, last access date), reputation and lifetime vote counters.
scope: Community user-level analysis across posts, comments, votes, badges and post links.

name: Post
definition: A content record in the community. The same table holds questions, answers, tag wiki entries and moderator-election records, distinguished by the post type value.
scope: Any question/answer/tag-wiki analysis; subtype must be selected through post_type.

name: Question
definition: A post whose post type value is 1. Questions are the only post kind that carry tags, view counts, answer counts, comment counts and favourite counts.
scope: Use whenever an analysis means 'questions' or 'posts that were asked'; excludes answers and wiki posts.

name: Answer
definition: A post whose post type value is 2; it always carries a parent post identifier that points to the question it answers.
scope: Answer-level analysis and derivation of answer counts.

name: Comment
definition: A short textual remark attached to a post, authored by a user and carrying its own score.
scope: Comment text search, comment score analysis, comment counting.

name: Vote
definition: A recorded vote action on a post. The vote type distinguishes accepted answers, up-votes, down-votes, favourites, bounty events, deletions and review actions.
scope: Vote-record counting. Per-user up/down vote attribution is not available in this data (see constraint_vote_user_attribution).

name: Badge Award
definition: An award of a named badge to a user at a specific date.
scope: Badge volume, badge-name and badge-award-time analysis.

name: Tag
definition: A topical label in the community tag vocabulary, with a usage count and optional excerpt/wiki post links.
scope: Tag vocabulary lookup and tag-level aggregation.

name: Post Link
definition: A directed link recorded between two posts, for example a duplicate marking or a related-link insertion.
scope: Link-volume analysis across posts and time.

name: User Display Name
definition: The public display name of a user account. Names are not unique across accounts.
scope: Locating users by name. Must be treated as a non-unique attribute.

name: User Age
definition: Self-declared age of a user account, in years.
scope: Age-based user analysis; sparsely populated.

name: Account Creation Date
definition: Timestamp at which the user account was created.
scope: Cohort analysis of registration period, e.g. accounts created in a given year.

name: Last Access Date
definition: Timestamp of the user's most recent access of the site.
scope: Activity-recency analysis, e.g. users active after a cutoff date.

name: Post Owner
definition: Identifier of the user who authored the post. Null for posts without a registered owner.
scope: Attributing posts to users and counting posts per user.

name: Post Title
definition: Human-readable title of a post. Populated for questions; absent for answers and other post kinds.
scope: Title lookup and title display.

name: Post Body
definition: The full rendered body text of a post, including markup.
scope: Body retrieval and body text search.

name: Post Creation Date
definition: Timestamp at which the post was created. For posts this is a distinct column from the creation-date column used by users, badges, votes, comments and post links.
scope: Time-window filtering of posts, e.g. posts created in a given year.

name: Post Type
definition: Categorical discriminator of what kind of record a post row is: question, answer, tag wiki excerpt, tag wiki, moderator nomination or moderator election.
scope: Always apply when a question says 'post' but means questions or answers.

name: Post Tags
definition: The set of tags attached to a question post, stored as concatenated angle-bracket tokens within a single field.
scope: Tag filtering and tag extraction from questions.

name: Post Last Editor
definition: Identifier of the user who most recently edited the post; null when the post was never edited.
scope: Editor attribution, including 'who last edited' phrasing.

name: Comment Text
definition: The body text of a comment.
scope: Comment content lookup and text matching.

name: Comment Author
definition: Identifier of the user who wrote a comment.
scope: Attributing comments to users.

name: Comment Author Display Name
definition: Denormalized display name stored alongside a comment. It is equal to the user's display name whenever it is populated, but it is present for only a small minority of comments.
scope: Convenience attribute only; prefer the user account display name for reliable attribution.

name: Vote Type
definition: Categorical discriminator of the vote action: accepted answer, up-vote, down-vote, favourite, bounty start, bounty close, deletion, undeletion, moderator review or edit-suggestion approval.
scope: Interpreting any vote record; required before counting 'votes'.

name: Vote Caster
definition: Identifier of the user who cast the vote. Populated only for favourite votes and bounty-start votes; null for essentially all other vote types.
scope: User-level vote attribution. Not usable alone for per-user up/down vote counts.

name: Badge Name
definition: The name of the awarded badge, for example Student, Supporter, Editor, Scholar or Teacher.
scope: Badge-type filtering and per-badge aggregation.

name: Badge Award Date
definition: Timestamp at which the badge was awarded to the user.
scope: Time-windowed badge analysis.

name: Tag Name
definition: The bare name of a tag in the tag vocabulary, without the angle-bracket encoding used inside post tag lists.
scope: Tag vocabulary lookup and joining tag metadata to questions.

name: Tag Post Count
definition: Denormalized count of question posts that carry this tag.
scope: Tag popularity measures.
aliases: number of posts with the tag

name: Tag Excerpt Post
definition: Identifier of the post that holds the tag's short excerpt (tag wiki excerpt). Null for tags that have no excerpt.
scope: Retrieving the excerpt text of a tag.

name: Tag Wiki Post
definition: Identifier of the post that holds the tag's full wiki description. Null for tags that have no wiki.
scope: Retrieving the full description of a tag.

name: Post Link Source Post
definition: Identifier of the post from which a post link originates.
scope: Linking analysis anchored on the source post.

name: Post Link Related Post
definition: Identifier of the post that a post link points to.
scope: Linking analysis anchored on the target post.

name: Post Link Type
definition: Categorical discriminator of the link relationship: a general linked-post relation or a duplicate marking.
scope: Distinguishing ordinary links from duplicate links.

name: Post Link Creation Date
definition: Timestamp at which the post link was recorded.
scope: Time-windowed link-volume analysis.

name: Post Score
definition: Net score of a post as maintained by the platform. It is a stored field, not recomputable from the vote records in this database.
scope: Ranking posts by score. Distinct from comment score even though both use the same physical field identifier in different tables.

name: Post View Count
definition: Number of times a question post has been viewed. Populated for questions only.
scope: Popularity analysis of questions.

name: Post Answer Count
definition: Denormalized number of answers attached to a question. It agrees with the count of answer posts whose parent is that question.
scope: Filtering questions by answer volume. Populated for questions only.

name: Post Comment Count
definition: Denormalized number of comments attached to a post. It almost always matches the count of comment rows, with a small number of exceptions.
scope: Filtering posts by comment volume, e.g. posts with zero or one comment.

name: Post Favorite Count
definition: Number of users who marked a question as a favourite. Represents the post's valued/saved popularity. Populated for a subset of questions.
scope: Measuring how valued a post is; used for 'most valuable post' phrasing.

name: Comment Score
definition: Net score of a comment. It shares the same physical field identifier as post score but lives in the comment table and applies to comments only.
scope: Ranking or filtering comments by score.

name: User Up Votes
definition: Lifetime count of up-votes cast by the user, maintained as a stored counter on the user account.
scope: Per-user up-vote analysis. This is the authoritative source because individual up-vote records lack user attribution.

name: User Down Votes
definition: Lifetime count of down-votes cast by the user, maintained as a stored counter on the user account.
scope: Per-user down-vote analysis.

name: User Reputation
definition: Accumulated reputation score of the user account.
scope: User ranking and 'valuable user' phrasing; distinct from the value of a single post.
